subject: Community Preservation Act Project Funding Recommendations
overview: The committee recommended funding for eleven Community Preservation Act projects and established specific grant conditions for historic preservation, ADA compliance, and maintenance. The body also discussed the transition to a new full-time CPA manager and postponed decisions on several remaining applications until February.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Administrative Updates
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from November 15 and discussed the city's posting for a new full-time CPA manager to replace the outgoing coordinator.

items.title: Shiloh Baptist Church Funding Recommendation
items.summary: Recommended $150,000 for exterior restoration with conditions requiring a preservation restriction and the exclusion of religious imagery from funded window panels.

items.title: Oak Grove Cemetery Caretaker Quarters
items.summary: Recommended $50,000 for a master planning study of the city-owned property, requiring the use of a qualified historic conservation professional.

items.title: McGlynn Playground Rehabilitation
items.summary: Recommended $500,000 for the project with the expectation that the applicant will seek the remaining balance in a future funding cycle. Conditions include guaranteed public access during non-school hours and the submission of a preventative maintenance plan.

items.title: Isaac Hall House (Islamic Cultural Center of Medford)
items.summary: Recommended $85,000 for restoration work, contingent on a preservation restriction and a conditions assessment performed prior to construction.

items.title: Housing Families Homelessness Prevention
items.summary: Recommended $10,000 for the housing support program.

items.title: Hickey Park Bench Shelters
items.summary: Recommended $90,000 for the installation of shelters, requiring an ADA compliance review of the site plan before installation begins.

items.title: Gillis Park Fitness and Picnic Area
items.summary: Recommended $96,864 for new park amenities, subject to a final design review for ADA and MAAB compliance.

items.title: Duggar Tennis Court Lacrosse Bounce Back
items.summary: Recommended an increased amount of $9,000 to include the installation of a commemorative plaque for Clarence Roan.

items.title: COVID Memorial Grove
items.summary: Recommended $28,000 for the design of a memorial grove, requiring that the final location be determined following community input.

items.title: Carr Park Pickleball Courts
items.summary: Recommended $202,000 for the construction of courts following a discussion regarding standard dimensions and lighting requirements.

items.title: Brooks Estate Access Drive Design
items.summary: Recommended funding for the access drive design as an amendment to an existing grant, maintaining previous historic landscape conditions.
